material_findings.dependency: x_i = CPSE_active(i)-CPSE_unrelated(i) uses model-derived data from confirmation families i and i+1; x_{i+1} reuses family i+1 as its own recipient/active source. Therefore adjacent signs share a confirmation-family random unit and are not independent under the stated Binomial(20,0.5) calibration.
material_findings.finding: UNRELATED_PLAN for confirmation family i is the active A-minus-B contrast of the next confirmation family in cyclic split order, while active_gt_unrelated is analyzed as an exact independent-family sign test.
material_findings.prospective_repair: Supersede v2.1 before any scientific execution. Keep manifest/model/layers/alphas/semantic manipulation/effect thresholds/T1 scope fixed. For confirmation family i, use a deterministic one-to-one donor from the DISJOINT 20-family discovery split for UNRELATED_PLAN. Freeze the discovery-donor bijection before any confirmation request and capture/freeze those donor directions during discovery. Then each confirmation statistic depends on its own confirmation family plus a fixed discovery donor, restoring the stated independent confirmation-family unit. Alternative: preregister a dependency-aware exact test, but the discovery-donor repair is simpler and more reviewer-defensible.
material_findings.why_material: The defect affects one of four Holm-corrected primary specificity tests, so a PASS could depend on a p-value whose claimed exact calibration is not justified.
